world.name: Novaris: The Buried City
world.description: A shared-world adventure set in the fortified city of Novaris and the forgotten ruins beneath it.

loc.novaris_gate.name: Novaris Gate
loc.novaris_gate.description: The eastern gate of Novaris, where caravans and travelers enter the city.

loc.watch_post.name: East Watch Post
loc.watch_post.description: A stone guard post overlooking the road beyond the city walls.

loc.guard_barracks.name: Guard Barracks
loc.guard_barracks.description: A busy barracks filled with weapon racks, maps, and tired city guards.

loc.training_yard.name: Training Yard
loc.training_yard.description: An open yard where recruits practice with wooden weapons.

loc.market_square.name: Market Square
loc.market_square.description: The crowded heart of Novaris, surrounded by merchants and narrow streets.

loc.merchant_row.name: Merchant Row
loc.merchant_row.description: A covered street packed with stalls selling food, cloth, maps, and curiosities.

loc.bakery.name: Golden Crust Bakery
loc.bakery.description: The warm scent of fresh bread fills this small but popular bakery.

loc.tavern.name: The Copper Tankard
loc.tavern.description: A lively tavern where travelers trade rumors beside a crackling hearth.

loc.blacksmith.name: Iron Ember Smithy
loc.blacksmith.description: Sparks fly from the forge as weapons and tools are repaired.

loc.fountain_plaza.name: Fountain Plaza
loc.fountain_plaza.description: A peaceful plaza centered around an old marble fountain.

loc.garden_gate.name: Royal Garden Gate
loc.garden_gate.description: An iron gate opens toward the gardens of the old royal quarter.

loc.residential_lane.name: Residential Lane
loc.residential_lane.description: A quiet lane lined with homes, laundry lines, and small workshops.

loc.temple_steps.name: Temple Steps
loc.temple_steps.description: Wide worn steps descend toward the ancient Temple of the Dawn.

loc.temple_hall.name: Temple Hall
loc.temple_hall.description: Sunlight falls through colored glass onto rows of silent stone benches.

loc.healer_room.name: Healer's Chamber
loc.healer_room.description: Shelves of herbs and bandages surround a clean treatment table.

loc.crypt_entrance.name: Forgotten Crypt Entrance
loc.crypt_entrance.description: A cracked stairway leads beneath the temple into darkness.

loc.crypt_hall.name: Crypt Hall
loc.crypt_hall.description: Ancient stone coffins line a cold underground corridor.

loc.crypt_chamber.name: Crypt Chamber
loc.crypt_chamber.description: A sealed chamber containing the remains of long-forgotten nobles.

loc.cemetery_gate.name: Cemetery Gate
loc.cemetery_gate.description: An iron gate marks the entrance to the city's old cemetery.

loc.cemetery.name: Old Cemetery
loc.cemetery.description: Weathered headstones stand beneath twisted trees and creeping mist.

loc.abandoned_chapel.name: Abandoned Chapel
loc.abandoned_chapel.description: A ruined chapel whose broken roof reveals the night sky.

loc.royal_gardens.name: Royal Gardens
loc.royal_gardens.description: Overgrown paths wind between statues, fountains, and flowering trees.

loc.garden_maze.name: Garden Maze
loc.garden_maze.description: Tall hedges form confusing passages around a hidden central shrine.

loc.maze_shrine.name: Moonlit Shrine
loc.maze_shrine.description: A small shrine illuminated by pale light even during the day.

loc.old_library.name: Old Library
loc.old_library.description: Dusty shelves preserve records from before the founding of modern Novaris.

loc.alley_of_whispers.name: Alley of Whispers
loc.alley_of_whispers.description: A narrow alley where every sound seems louder than it should be.

loc.hidden_door.name: Hidden Door
loc.hidden_door.description: A concealed doorway behind stacked crates leads into the undercity.

loc.smugglers_tunnel.name: Smugglers' Tunnel
loc.smugglers_tunnel.description: A damp tunnel once used to move goods beneath the city walls.

loc.riverside_path.name: Riverside Path
loc.riverside_path.description: A stone path follows the river beneath the western district.

loc.docks.name: Novaris Docks
loc.docks.description: Cargo ships and fishing boats crowd the wooden piers.

loc.warehouse.name: Old Warehouse
loc.warehouse.description: A large warehouse containing crates, ropes, and suspicious locked containers.

loc.lighthouse_road.name: Lighthouse Road
loc.lighthouse_road.description: A coastal road leading away from the city toward a lonely lighthouse.

loc.lighthouse.name: Grey Beacon Lighthouse
loc.lighthouse.description: A tall lighthouse whose keeper watches the sea from above.

loc.west_gate.name: West Gate
loc.west_gate.description: The western gate opens toward the hills and the old forest road.

loc.forest_road.name: Forest Road
loc.forest_road.description: An old road disappears into dense forest beyond the safety of the walls.

loc.bandit_camp.name: Bandit Camp
loc.bandit_camp.description: A hidden camp with abandoned tents and a smoking fire pit.

loc.ruined_tower.name: Ruined Tower
loc.ruined_tower.description: The remains of a watchtower rise above the surrounding forest.

loc.cave_entrance.name: Cave Entrance
loc.cave_entrance.description: Cold air flows from a jagged opening in the hillside.

loc.deep_cave.name: Deep Cave
loc.deep_cave.description: Underground water echoes through a vast natural cavern.

loc.crystal_cavern.name: Crystal Cavern
loc.crystal_cavern.description: Glowing crystals illuminate the cavern with an eerie shimmer.

loc.sewer_junction.name: Sewer Junction
loc.sewer_junction.description: Several ancient tunnels meet beneath Novaris; the water is dark and fast.

loc.flooded_sewer.name: Flooded Sewer
loc.flooded_sewer.description: A partially flooded branch of the undercity hides dangerous creatures.

loc.underground_lake.name: Underground Lake
loc.underground_lake.description: A silent black lake stretches beneath the foundations of the city.

loc.undercity_ruins.name: Undercity Ruins
loc.undercity_ruins.description: The buried remains of an older settlement lie beneath Novaris.

loc.ancient_vault.name: Ancient Vault
loc.ancient_vault.description: A sealed vault containing relics from a civilization older than the city.

item.novaris_coins.name: Novaris Coins
item.novaris_coins.description: A pouch of minted silver coins used as currency.

item.guard_sword.name: Guard Sword
item.guard_sword.description: A reliable iron sword issued to city guards.

item.training_sword.name: Training Sword
item.training_sword.description: A blunt wooden sword for practice.

item.iron_shield.name: Iron Shield
item.iron_shield.description: A round shield that can block part of an incoming attack.

item.healing_herbs.name: Healing Herbs
item.healing_herbs.description: A bundle of medicinal herbs useful to the city healer.

item.fresh_bread.name: Fresh Bread
item.fresh_bread.description: Warm bread from the Golden Crust Bakery.

item.blacksmith_hammer.name: Blacksmith Hammer
item.blacksmith_hammer.description: A heavy hammer used for shaping hot metal.

item.tavern_key.name: Tavern Key
item.tavern_key.description: A brass key that opens a locked cellar door.

item.old_map.name: Old Map
item.old_map.description: A worn map showing several forgotten passages.

item.library_note.name: Library Note
item.library_note.description: A note describing the location of an ancient vault.

item.temple_medallion.name: Temple Medallion
item.temple_medallion.description: A bronze medallion marked with the symbol of the Dawn.

item.crypt_key.name: Crypt Key
item.crypt_key.description: An old iron key found near the sealed crypts.

item.bandit_dagger.name: Bandit Dagger
item.bandit_dagger.description: A short dagger carried by forest bandits.

item.bandit_shield.name: Bandit Buckler
item.bandit_shield.description: A small shield made from reinforced wood.

item.smugglers_manifest.name: Smugglers Manifest
item.smugglers_manifest.description: A list of illegal shipments moving through the docks.

item.warehouse_key.name: Warehouse Key
item.warehouse_key.description: A rusted key to a locked warehouse chest.

item.fishing_net.name: Fishing Net
item.fishing_net.description: A sturdy net used by the dock workers.

item.lighthouse_lens.name: Lighthouse Lens
item.lighthouse_lens.description: A damaged lens that the keeper wants repaired.

item.crystal_shard.name: Crystal Shard
item.crystal_shard.description: A glowing fragment from the Crystal Cavern.

item.ancient_relic.name: Ancient Relic
item.ancient_relic.description: A valuable artifact recovered from the undercity.

item.vault_seal.name: Vault Seal
item.vault_seal.description: A stone seal engraved with symbols from the old civilization.

item.guard_armor.name: Guard Armor
item.guard_armor.description: Heavy protective armor unsuitable for quick movement.

item.mysterious_orb.name: Mysterious Orb
item.mysterious_orb.description: A strange orb humming with faint energy.

item.rope.name: Rope
item.rope.description: Useful for climbing, pulling, or securing objects.

item.healers_potion.name: Healers Potion
item.healers_potion.description: A prepared medicine kept by the temple healer.

npc.captain_elian.name: Captain Elian
npc.captain_elian.description: The disciplined commander of Novaris' city guard.
dialogue: Keep the city safe. Trouble often begins where nobody is watching.
Bread from Toma? Bless that baker.

npc.recruit_mara.name: Recruit Mara
npc.recruit_mara.description: A young guard learning the rules of combat.
dialogue: One day I will earn a real guard's sword.

npc.baker_toma.name: Baker Toma
npc.baker_toma.description: A cheerful baker worried about missing herb deliveries.
dialogue: Captain Elian has not eaten all day. Could you bring him some Fresh Bread?
If you see Healing Herbs, Healer Aria needs them more than I do.

npc.lyra_the_merchant.name: Lyra the Merchant
npc.lyra_the_merchant.description: A traveling merchant with an eye for valuable curiosities.
dialogue: Coins speak clearly, but rare relics can say even more.

npc.blacksmith_borin.name: Borin Ironhand
npc.blacksmith_borin.description: A master blacksmith who values good ore and honest work.
dialogue: Bring me proper tools and I can forge something worthy.

npc.innkeeper_sela.name: Innkeeper Sela
npc.innkeeper_sela.description: The tavern keeper who hears every rumor in town.
dialogue: Rumors are free here. Believing them may cost you.

npc.healer_aria.name: Healer Aria
npc.healer_aria.description: A temple healer searching for medicinal herbs.
dialogue: The city needs Healing Herbs. Bring them to me and I can prepare medicine.
Herbs, bread or potions: anything you USE in a fight will help you survive.

npc.priest_oren.name: Priest Oren
npc.priest_oren.description: An elderly priest guarding the temple's history.
dialogue: The stones below this temple remember more than the people above.

npc.gravekeeper_nolan.name: Gravekeeper Nolan
npc.gravekeeper_nolan.description: A quiet caretaker who knows the cemetery better than anyone.
dialogue: Some doors are better left closed, especially in the crypts.

npc.librarian_ves.name: Librarian Ves
npc.librarian_ves.description: A scholar obsessed with records of the buried undercity.
dialogue: The old records point toward an undercity. Find the missing archive.

npc.gardener_elin.name: Gardener Elin
npc.gardener_elin.description: A royal gardener tending plants that have outlived the monarchy.
dialogue: These gardens have survived kings, wars, and neglect.

npc.the_whisper.name: The Whisper
npc.the_whisper.description: A suspicious informant who appears briefly in the alley.
dialogue: The smugglers move beneath your feet. Follow the wrong shadow and you may find them.

npc.smuggler_vex.name: Vex
npc.smuggler_vex.description: A smuggler guarding the route beneath the city.
dialogue: Turn around, or the tunnel becomes your grave.

npc.dockmaster_ren.name: Dockmaster Ren
npc.dockmaster_ren.description: The person responsible for cargo and ship schedules.
dialogue: A manifest vanished with one of my shipments. Vex knows something about it.

npc.lighthouse_keeper_ira.name: Lighthouse Keeper Ira
npc.lighthouse_keeper_ira.description: A lonely keeper trying to repair the Grey Beacon.
dialogue: The beacon is failing. A Crystal Shard may help focus its light.
Ren's docks must be safe before I can trust anyone with the lens.

npc.bandit_leader_karg.name: Bandit Leader Karg
npc.bandit_leader_karg.description: The dangerous leader of a small forest band.
dialogue: Your coin or your life. I'll take both.

npc.bandit_scout.name: Bandit Scout
npc.bandit_scout.description: A lookout watching the forest road.
dialogue: Halt! The road belongs to Karg now.

npc.cave_stalker.name: Cave Stalker
npc.cave_stalker.description: A hostile creature living in the deeper caverns.
dialogue: A low hiss echoes from the dark.

npc.giant_sewer_rat.name: Giant Sewer Rat
npc.giant_sewer_rat.description: An unusually large and aggressive rat.
dialogue: It squeaks furiously and bares its teeth.

npc.ruined_guardian.name: Ruined Guardian
npc.ruined_guardian.description: An ancient construct protecting the undercity ruins.
dialogue: INTRUDER. THE UNDERCITY SLEEPS.

npc.vault_sentinel.name: Vault Sentinel
npc.vault_sentinel.description: The final guardian standing before the ancient vault.
dialogue: None shall break the seal.

quest.herbal_remedy.name: Herbal Remedy
quest.herbal_remedy.description: Collect Healing Herbs and deliver them to Healer Aria.

quest.forge_supplies.name: Forge Supplies
quest.forge_supplies.description: Recover the Blacksmith Hammer from the abandoned warehouse area.

quest.smugglers_manifest.name: Smugglers Manifest
quest.smugglers_manifest.description: Defeat Vex and recover the Smugglers' Manifest.

quest.lost_archive.name: The Lost Archive
quest.lost_archive.description: Find the Old Map and the Library Note, then return to Librarian Ves.

quest.restore_beacon.name: Restore the Beacon
quest.restore_beacon.description: Bring a Crystal Shard to Keeper Ira to help repair the lighthouse.

quest.bread_delivery.name: Bread for the Captain
quest.bread_delivery.description: Take a loaf of Fresh Bread from the bakery and deliver it to Captain Elian in the barracks.
